Our Gym

Numbers don't lie. Neither do we.

BARWORKS is a strength gym built around the big three. Every program is coached, every lift is logged, and every plateau gets a plan instead of a guess.

Lifts

Train the big numbers

LOWER BODY

Squat

Progressive squat programming built on depth, bar position, and a base that gets heavier every block.

UPPER BODY

Bench Press

Pressing strength built through structured accessory work and technique coaching, not just volume.

POSTERIOR CHAIN

Deadlift

Pull mechanics, bracing, and progressive loading for a lift that rewards patience over ego.

HYPERTROPHY

Accessory Work

The unglamorous volume work that fixes weak points and keeps the big three moving up.
